features: Institution Rejection Multi-DocType Reflection: SFE rejection cause note automatically reflected across HCP, HCP Account, and HCP Profile Submission
Pre-Submission Guard in HCP Wizard: Prevents profiling submissions with rejected institutions, presenting a detailed cause note
Lockscreen & Logged-Out Heads-Up Notifications: Public high-priority alerts notify MedReps even when logged out via cached last active user in SharedPreferences
SFE Remediation & Remapping Hub: SFE Specialists can remap rejected facilities to approved masterlist facilities, unblocking MedRep profiling
Label Standardization: Renamed 'Doctor Listing' to 'HCP' and 'Doctor Account' to 'HCP Account' throughout navigation, dashboard, and headers
Comprehensive Simulation Suite: 1-tap in-app simulation icon in SFE Dashboard, automated Python test script, and simulation runbook in docs/
